text.feels_intro: How {name}'s frostbite feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: pale, numb-looking skin with a rime of frost on {his} lashes and hair.
{name}'s face: waxy, bluish-white patches of frostbite on {his} cheeks, nose and ears.
{name}'s face: dead-white, hard, frozen skin; ice crusts {his} lips and eyelids. {name} smells of cold, damp wool and frozen skin.
body: {name}'s back: pale skin, stiff with cold, a rime of frost on {his} clothing.
{name}'s back: waxy, bluish-white patches of frostbite show where {his} clothing is stiff with ice.
{name}'s back: hard, frozen skin, ice crystals glittering on a stiff, frozen back. A cold, damp smell like snowmelt clings to {him}.
arm: {name}'s {part}: pale, numb skin with frost on the sleeve.
{name}'s {part}: bluish-white frostbitten skin; the fingers are stiff.
{name}'s {part}: hard, frozen, dead-white skin; ice crusts the fingers.
leg: {name}'s {part}: pale, numb skin with frost on {his} clothing.
{name}'s {part}: bluish-white frostbitten patches; the leg is stiff.
{name}'s {part}: hard, frozen, dead-white flesh; ice crusts {his} boot and the leg barely moves.

head: {name}'s face is numb and prickling, {his} breath puffing white. {name} is shivering and wary.
{name}'s face aches with a deep, biting cold and {his} teeth chatter. {name} is shaken and slurs slightly.
{name}'s face has gone numb and wooden and the cold is crushing. {name} is drowsy, disoriented and terrified.
body: {name}'s back is chilled and stiff, and {he} shivers hard. {name} hunches against the cold.
{name}'s back aches with bone-deep cold and every movement cracks. {name} is shuddering and miserable.
{name}'s back is numb, wooden and heavy with cold. {name} is drowsy, barely able to move and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} is numb and stiff, the fingers clumsy. {name} rubs it and shivers.
{name}'s {part} aches with a deep, biting cold. {name} can barely close {his} fingers.
{name}'s {part} is numb and dead. {name} cannot feel or move it and is frightened.
leg: {name}'s {part} is numb and stiff, the steps clumsy. {name} shivers and stamps it.
{name}'s {part} aches with a deep, biting cold. {name} walks stiff-legged, stumbling.
{name}'s {part} is numb and dead weight. {name} cannot feel it and falls or must be supported.

levels: , a shock of biting cold. Frost bites at {his} skin, and {he} gasps and shivers.
over skin that is already numb with cold. The frost bites deeper, and {he} gasps as {his} skin stiffens.
, and the cold sinks deep into the frostbitten flesh. {he} chokes on a cry as {his} skin hardens and {his} movements slow.
, and it is too much. The cold crushes {him}; {he} goes blue and still, {his} breath rasping and {his} limbs refusing to answer.

start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

head: the frost freezes {his} face; the eyes turn milky white and ice crusts the lashes, the skin goes grey-blue and cracks, and blood seeps from the splits in red crystals. {name} topples stiffly, a last frozen breath misting from {his} lips, and the air smells of cold metal and blood.

the cold bites into {his} skull until the eyes burst into ice and dark, slushy blood weeps from the hollow sockets; {his} jaw locks with frost thick in the open mouth. {name} falls without a cry, the sharp smell of frozen blood hanging in the cold.
body: the frost drives into {his} chest until the heart seizes; the skin of {his} back is white and rigid as stone and blood freezes in red crystals where it splits. {name} falls stiff, a thin, crackling gasp leaving {him}, and a smell of cold iron and frozen flesh hangs about the body.

the cold freezes {his} lungs mid-breath; frost spreads over {his} chest and back, the flesh cracking open in deep, bloodless fissures that glitter with red ice. {name} sinks down, rigid and blue-lipped, a last strangled wheeze leaving {him} in a frozen mist.
arm: {his} {part} freezes solid and snaps off at the elbow like a dead branch; the stump is a frozen knot of white bone and grey muscle, blood oozing slowly in red slush. {name} stares at it, screaming, and dies shaking in the cold, the smell of frozen blood sharp on the air.

the frost turns {his} {part} to ice; the skin splits to the bone and the fingers break off when they strike the ground. {name} collapses, shuddering, {his} last cries thin and frozen, the air smelling of cold metal and blood.
leg: {his} {part} freezes through and shatters like ice under {his} weight, and {he} falls beside a frozen stump of bone and muscle, blood seeping out in dark red slush. {name}'s screams fade into a shivering moan, and the cold smell of frozen blood hangs over {him} as {he} dies.

the cold freezes {his} {part} solid to the hip; the flesh cracks open in white, bloodless splits and the leg breaks with a sharp snap as {he} falls. {name} dies there, rigid and blue, {his} final scream frozen in a cloud of breath.

soil: As {his} body goes slack, {his} bowels and bladder let go, and the warm stink of shit and piss steams in the cold.
In death the stench of {his} shit and piss spreads, warm and rank against the frozen air.
